column1: # LOCK-GEAR-0002: every class at the first level of each grade whose level it can have, made and taught by the server, in the lowest armour set of that grade and of its armour category (its own or its nearest ancestor's),
# holding nothing and the lowest plain weapon of each kind of that grade (no special ability, PvP, shadow, common or timed copy), a bow or crossbow with the grade's arrows or bolts; no jewels.
# A grade marked (above) is the next one, its armour and sword, which the character's expertise does not reach.
